description: This file defines an abstract base class 'TestlinkPlugin' for TestLink plugins, including properties for plugin metadata, lifecycle methods, and hook registration, serving as the foundational file for plugin development within the TestLink project.

classes.name: TestlinkPlugin
classes.description: An abstract base class providing core functionality and lifecycle management for TestLink plugins, including properties for plugin metadata and methods for registration, setup, and hooks.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to register the plugin.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Method to set up plugin environment, including API inclusion and event hooking.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Method to handle plugin installation activities; returns true by default.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Method to handle plugin uninstallation activities.

methods.name: hooks
methods.description: Defines the hooks exposed by the plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection and registration.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Sets default configuration, registers hooks, and calls init routine.
